subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3742
title: Provides that members of the Legislative Assembly and legislative branch employees who have a valid concealed handgun license have an affirmative defense to a charge of possessing a firearm within the Capitol, and may not be arrested or charged for the offense while in possession of the license.
headline: HB 3742 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3742 was introduced in the House on February 25, 2025.
HB 3742 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
